caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair placed centrally on a plain, cream-colored background. The chair is composed of light brown wood with three horizontal slats forming the backrest, each curved slightly. The rear vertical posts are topped with rounded finials. The seat is woven in a light tan or beige material, likely straw or rush. The chair legs and support bars are depicted with a cylindrical form. The two curved wooden rockers at the base are distinctly shown, with the right rocker rendered in a darker, reddish-brown shade compared to the lighter left rocker. There are no other objects or additional elements in the composition, and the background is blank except for some faint markings and text near the lower edge.
